description:
Bypass. With tests: deny, pre_bash allows: mv/cp/install/rsync into tests/, git checkout|restore -- tests/x, git rm, git apply /tmp/p.diff, patch -p1 <, git stash pop, tar -x, unzip -d tests.

Causes:
1. tests_policy.is_test_path drops the last path part, so a destination dir named tests is not a test path.
2. write_targets.py:29-38 and pre_bash.py:267-272 do not model these verbs as test writes.

Fix: when a copy destination is a directory, join it with the source name, count a last part named tests or __tests__ as a test dir, and block git checkout/restore/rm/apply/stash pop, patch, tar -x and unzip when they target a test path or name no paths (git apply, patch, stash pop) while the gate is closed.

Acceptance: each command above blocks under deny, passes under allow and for the test writer. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Gate shell routes that change test files
